messages.text:
Hello - nerdoctaxe miner resets every couple of hours and the only thing I can see in the system is "Last Reset Reason:	Task watchdog reset"

Not sure what is causing it
Searched the web · NerdOctaxe "Task watchdog reset" ESP-Miner
Searched the web · shufps ESP-Miner-NerdQAxePlus watchdog reset issue

Hi Michal, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

**What the message means:** I looked it up rather than going from memory. "Task watchdog reset" is a general feature of the ESP32 controller chip. It isn't an error code specific to the NerdOctaxe. The chip watches its own background tasks, and if one stops responding for a few seconds, it restarts itself. In another ESP32 project, for example, the developers found that 
a short WiFi/TCP stall can therefore block the loop > 5 s → TWDT
.

**What usually causes it:** Most often the firmware, the network or the settings. A hardware fault is less likely. I've seen a similar pattern on the NerdQAxe firmware, which your NerdOctaxe also runs. One owner reported that 
he reinstalled v1.0.34.1 on both miners after they both experienced multiple software panic resets. No more issues or errors with v1.0.34.1 reloaded.
 So the firmware version is the first thing I need to know.

**Next step:** Please open the miner's web page, go to the **System** page and send me:
1. The firmware version
2. Your frequency and core voltage, and whether you've changed them from the defaults

A screenshot of that page is fine.

Model:	NerdOCTAXE-γ (BM1370)
Version:	v1.0.36-1-g1cb9f62a
FRequency: 740
Core V: 1180

I didnt change anything, this is as arrived
I'll check which firmware release is the latest for the NerdOCTAXE-γ.

Thanks Michal. Your v1.0.36 is out of date, and that's the first thing to fix.

**Why I think it's the firmware:** Other owners have reported random resets on exactly your firmware line. One open report is titled "Software Panic Resets - v1.0.35 thru v1.1.0". The owner writes that his miners had been running the same setup and pool for months on end, error-free, until v1.0.35. Since then the developer has released fixes for this. One build tries to fix random fw crashes that happen for some users after 2-3 days, and another adds stability improvements especially on edge cases like wifi connection problems and stratum ping.

Your frequency and voltage are as the unit arrived, so leave them alone for now. We'll change one thing at a time.

**Next step, update the firmware:**
1. In the miner's web page, open the System / Update section.
2. Use the one-click GitHub updater. Don't use the old updater in the "Danger Zone". The developer explains it was often used only half-way: firmware flashed, web assets forgotten, leaving the UI in a mismatched state. The one-click updater keeps firmware and web UI in lockstep.
3. The GitHub updater always lists the latest release first and preselects it. Pick the newest normal release. Skip anything marked "rc", "test", "beta" or "pre-release".
4. Let it reboot. Don't unplug it while it updates.

This is the official firmware for the NerdOCTAXE-γ, so it doesn't affect your warranty.

When it's done, please tell me the new version number. Then leave the miner running for a few hours and check the "Last Reset Reason" again. If it still resets on the new version, our next step is to look at power and WiFi.
